target_customer: Consumers with eczema and chronic skin conditions, including parents buying for babies
problem: Eczema sufferers rely on steroids or generic moisturizers. Soteri sells non-steroidal creams that correct skin pH using a patented pH/LOCK complex.
business_model: Direct to consumer skincare with subscriptions (15 percent subscription discount) and some retail

founders.name: Rafal Pielak
prior_employers: L'Oreal (7 years leading a product innovation team, helped launch the L'Oreal Tech Incubator in San Francisco)
education: PhD Biomedical Chemistry and Molecular Pharmacology, Harvard Medical School
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. A search snippet says his wife and daughter's eczema motivated the company, not confirmed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Formulation and a 30 person clinical trial with dermatologists plus patent filings, but over the counter skincare has modest regulatory burden.

defensibility.rationale: Company reports patented pH/LOCK technology (CB Insights reports four filed patents, unverified). Big skincare brands can still sell similar creams.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: One undated aggregator lists these as competitors. No copy of the pH claim was found.

market_need_then: Eczema is common and parents seek steroid-free options. The company site cites a 4 week trial of 30 participants run by dermatologists, a company claim.

identity.visual_style: A design studio portfolio page describes the identity as geometry, balance and protection

branding.community_and_virality: Listed on the National Eczema Association product directory and launched on Product Hunt April 12, 2022; retail expansion to Showfields in New York per RetailBoss.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear differentiator name and some retail and trade press, but little consumer scale shown.

outcome_analysis: Soteri Skin joined YC in Winter 2022 and sells four pH correcting eczema creams direct to consumers, with a patent claim, a small clinical trial and retail presence at Showfields. No verified funding, exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is unknown and the stage stays early.
notes: Funding of about $500K (CB Insights 2 rounds incl. Launch Lab X October 2022, Extruct pre-seed $125K March 2022) appears only on aggregators with conflicting data and is unverified. The Harvard Innovation Labs page returned 403 and was not read. A snippet names Jen Wan as co-founder, but no opened company source says so, so she is not listed. Competitors CeraVe, Eucerin and La Roche-Posay come from an undated aggregator, so the list is empty. Founding year is 2021 per aggregators, not confirmed. No outcome news found.
